verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for an SDK-based analytics and experimentation platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no setting to disable usage tracking or event logging. The only related evidence says gate checks 'automatically log exposure events' and the SDKs are built to send data into Statsig, which describes tracking rather than an opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
